title: Brand direction
exampleNote: Illustrative copy — not verified business claims.
valuesCaveat: Built on one designer's reading of eight choices. It won't tell you what your business values — that conversation is still yours to have.

directions.name: Quiet and precise
directions.character: Your choices lean toward a quiet, precise look: restrained typography, generous space, and clear detail. Nothing shouts, everything sits where it belongs, and the work is left to speak for itself.
directions.try: What you do, what it costs, when it's ready.
directions.mood: Off-white, ink, one cool accent; one restrained typeface, generous space, small type held together by alignment.

example.headline: Glasses that fit the way you read.

directions.name: Warm and handmade
directions.character: Your choices lean toward a warm, handmade look: tactile materials, softer edges, and personal language. Things look touched by a person, not produced by a system.
directions.try: Who made it, who's behind the counter, come in and try.
directions.mood: Paper, clay, deep green; one typeface with visible character, softer edges, text set like a note.

example.headline: Come in and taste before you decide.

directions.name: Bold and direct
directions.character: Your choices lean toward a bold, direct look: strong contrast, large type, and short messages. Plain words, one idea at a time, no hedging.
directions.try: The offer and the benefit in under eight words.
directions.useSparingly: Qualifiers, long sentences, three ideas in one line.
directions.mood: One saturated colour plus black; heavy weights, tight leading, big first line.
